welcome.intro: See the energy use of your home, live and back in time.
welcome.label: EMON ID
welcome.helpTitle: Where do I find my EMON ID?
welcome.helpText: You saw your EMON ID when you set up the meter kit through the Wi-Fi network "ETI EMON config". Lost it? Disconnect the power of the kit, hold button Sw1 and reconnect the power. Then connect to "ETI EMON config": your EMON ID is shown on the screen.

errors.invalid_format: An EMON ID has 12 characters (digits 0–9 and letters A–F).
errors.not_found: No data found for this EMON ID. Check the ID; if your meter has only just started sending data, try again later.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
errors.session_expired: The data cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.upstream_unavailable: The data cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
errors.conflict: Someone else has changed this in the meantime. Reload and try again.

live.title: Live
live.offlineTitle: Your meter has not sent data since {{time}}.
live.offlineHelp: Check that the meter kit has power and that your Wi-Fi works. If that does not help, disconnect the power briefly and reconnect it.
live.chartLabel: Chart of the net power over the last 24 hours
live.gasChartLabel: Bar chart of the gas use per hour over the last 24 hours
live.gasHourlyNote: Your meter reports the gas reading once an hour; use shows up an hour later.

history.title: History
history.energyChart: Bar chart of import and export in this period
history.gasChart: Bar chart of the gas use in this period
history.zoomHint: Tap a bar to zoom in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.removeConfirmText: The app forgets your EMON ID and settings on this device. You can enter it again later.
settings.unavailable: Meter information is not available right now.
settings.countersSwappedHelp: The import and export counters of your meter appear to be swapped (possibly a wiring error). The app corrects this automatically.
settings.aboutPartners: Avans Hogeschool and HZ University of Applied Sciences
settings.installUnsupported: Installing as an app works in Chrome, Edge or Safari.
settings.aboutLicense: Open source under the Apache 2.0 license
settings.licensesError: The licenses could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

install.title: Install as app
install.bannerText: Add Energiemeter to your home screen for quick access.
install.after: Then open Energiemeter from your home screen, just like an app.

ios.1: Tap the Share button: in Safari at the bottom (iPhone) or top (iPad), in Chrome and Edge next to the address bar.
ios.2: Scroll and choose Add to Home Screen.

macos.1: In the menu bar, choose File → Add to Dock.

tariffs.title: Tariffs
tariffs.intro: Enter the tariffs of your energy contract to see your costs. When your tariff changes, add a new period from the start date.
tariffs.compareHelp: Add a second contract, for example a dynamic one, to see what you would have paid with it.
tariffs.nameHelp: For example the name of the supplier and the type of contract.
tariffs.removeCompareText: The comparison contract and its tariff periods are removed. You can bring it back through earlier versions.
tariffs.deleteText: The period from {{date}} is deleted. You can bring it back through earlier versions.
tariffs.restoreText: The tariffs of this version become the current ones. The current tariffs are kept as an earlier version.

errors.conflict: The tariffs were changed elsewhere in the meantime. They have been reloaded; please try again.
errors.rate_limited: You changed the tariffs many times in the past hour. Try again later.

fields.dynamicMarkupPerKwh: Markup on the export price per kWh
fields.name: Name (optional)

tariffs.validFromHelp: The date these tariffs take effect.
tariffs.inclHelp: Incl. energy tax and VAT, as on your annual statement.
tariffs.markupHelp: Your supplier's purchase fee on top of the market price; may be negative.
tariffs.energyTaxHelp: Energy tax; see the Belastingdienst rates or your contract.
tariffs.compensationHelp: What you receive per kWh you export more than you import (until 2026) or per exported kWh (from 2027).
tariffs.feeHelp: Fee your supplier charges per exported kWh; often 0.
tariffs.dynamicMarkupHelp: Correction on the market price for export, excl. VAT; often negative. Empty = 0.
tariffs.supplierHelp: Fixed supplier charge for electricity and gas together, incl. VAT.
tariffs.gridHelp: Grid operator charge for electricity and gas together, incl. VAT.
tariffs.taxReductionHelp: Energy tax reduction, also called heffingskorting; as a positive amount, incl. VAT.
tariffs.statementHint: You find the amounts on your contract or annual statement. Use a comma or a dot as decimal separator.
tariffs.invalidDate: Enter a date that is not in use yet.
tariffs.namePeriodHelp: To recognise this period in the list.
tariffs.compareOffNote: The comparison is off: the tariff periods are kept, but Live and History show no comparison.

costs.title: Costs
costs.estimatedNote: Estimated: meter data is missing; the use is spread over that period.
costs.proRataNote: Fixed costs and tax reduction count pro rata for the part of the day that has passed.
costs.chartLabel: Bar chart of the costs per period, with a line for the comparison contract

basis.last-year: based on the same days last year
basis.mixed: based on last year and the last 30 days

costs.hint: Enter your tariffs to see costs
